audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 disagrees with itself. win[4] and phases[4] give the stage to Neeko, but spikes[1].text calls it 'your one clean window', mid says 'this is your window if you play it clean', and whys[4] says the Ultimatum isolates and deletes her. Three strings say Camille, the row says Neeko.
audit.why: 47.91% over 215 games is an unfavoured lane, so a Neeko-sided level 6 is arguable on the numbers - but the prose is unambiguous in the other direction and I will not guess which the user wants.
audit.corrected: Left the row and the prose untouched and raised it in questionsForUser rather than invent a power shift a player would trust.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole matchup is keyed to 'when her E is on cooldown' and 'wait it out' and never gives a number. Tangle-Barbs is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, Blooming Burst 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, Shapesplitter 16/15/14/13/12s, Pop Blossom 120/105/90s.
audit.why: Cooldowns from champ-data/_kits/neeko.json. The 12s on Tangle-Barbs at rank 1 is the entire dive window this page tells you to wait for.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text, mid, wants.you[0] and whys[5] now carry Tangle-Barbs' 12s.

audit.whatIsWrong: One error and two missing interactions that decide the lane. (1) 'her flash/Q escape' - Blooming Burst is a thrown seed, not an escape; her mobility is Shapesplitter's move speed. (2) Inherent Glamour breaks the moment she takes immobilizing crowd control, so your own Hookshot knock-up strips a disguised Neeko's cover - the single best counter to the clone game this page keeps warning about, and it is nowhere. (3) Pop Blossom's wind-up is HIDDEN while she is disguised, which is precisely why a disguised Neeko walking at you is lethal and why 'never facecheck the clone' is not strong enough advice. Also missing: Tangle-Barbs grows larger, faster and roots longer after passing through a champion or killing a unit, so a root fired through the wave is the dangerous one.
audit.why: Riot, Inherent Glamour: 'Receiving immobilizing crowd control, casting damaging spells, damaging enemy towers as a non-champion... breaks the disguise.' Pop Blossom: 'After a short preparation, Neeko leaps into the air... The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised.' Tangle-Barbs: 'If the tangle kills an enemy or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer.'
audit.corrected: wants.you[1] drops the invented Q escape; early, mid and late now use the Hookshot-breaks-disguise rule and the hidden Pop Blossom wind-up, and spikes[0].text names the through-the-wave Tangle-Barbs as the version to fear.

edits.after: A point in E plus your Q recast lets you punch back, but with no gap-close you only trade if you sidestep Tangle-Barbs — through the minion wave it roots far longer.

edits.before: Neeko's Blooming Burst poke and the threat of her Tangle-Barbs root own Level 1, when you have only one ability and no all-in. Do not walk up for a Q trade in a static lane where her E can root you in place for free poke. Last-hit at range, respect that eating her root with your E down is a death sentence, and watch for the Shapesplitter clone walking at you to bait a cooldown. Once you have your Q true-damage recast and a point in E at 2-3, you can answer her — but only if you dodge the root and stick.
edits.after: Neeko's Blooming Burst poke and the threat of her Tangle-Barbs root own Level 1, when you have only one ability and no all-in. Do not walk up for a Q trade in a static lane where her E can root you in place for free poke — and a root fired through the wave is bigger, faster and longer. Last-hit at range, and if you suspect a disguise, remember your Hookshot knock-up breaks Inherent Glamour outright. From 2-3 with the Q recast you can answer her, but only if you dodge the root.

edits.before: This is your window if you play it clean. At 6 your Hextech Ultimatum isolates her in the arena where her clone disguise and roam threat mean nothing, and Q-recast plus W's outer-edge max-HP slash burn a squishy Neeko down fast. The whole fight is her E: bait the root with the clone or wait it out, then E-in, R, Q-recast. If you commit your E and she still has Tangle-Barbs up, she roots you, lands Pop Blossom, and you die instead — so always force her root first.
edits.after: This is your window if you play it clean. At 6 your Hextech Ultimatum isolates her in the arena where the clone and the roam threat mean nothing, and Q-recast plus W's outer-edge max-HP slash burn her down fast. The whole fight is her E: bait the root or wait its 12s, then E-in, R, Q-recast. Commit with Tangle-Barbs up and she roots you, lands Pop Blossom and you die instead — worse, while she is disguised the Pop Blossom wind-up is hidden, so you get no warning at all.

edits.before: You delete her in a clean 1v1, but the game stops being a 1v1. Her Tangle-Barbs root and her huge Pop Blossom AOE stun scale into team utility that hard-counters your dive: one missed dodge and you get rooted, then stunned, and her team turns you to dust before your shield matters. Win lane and snowball a lead before her pick-setup decides fights. Flank to isolate her real body with R, and never facecheck the clone.
edits.after: You delete her in a clean 1v1, but the game stops being a 1v1. Tangle-Barbs and her huge Pop Blossom AOE stun scale into team utility that hard-counters your dive: one missed dodge and you get rooted, then stunned. Win lane and snowball before her pick-setup decides fights. Flank to isolate her real body with R — and if you cannot tell which is real, your Hookshot knock-up breaks the disguise, because any immobilize does.

edits.before: Hookshot (E) unlocks your wall-dash stun and attack-speed burst. Only take a wall trade when Neeko's Tangle-Barbs is down, then peel out on the bonus move speed before he answers. This is a clean skill phase.
edits.after: Hookshot (E) unlocks your wall-dash knock-up and attack-speed burst. Only take a wall trade when Neeko's Tangle-Barbs is down, then peel out on the bonus move speed before he answers. This is a clean skill phase.

edits.before: Good trade: Lead with the W outer edge as Neeko steps to last-hit, weave the empowered Q2 true damage, then peel out on your bonus move speed before the fight goes long. Great trade: Neeko uses or whiffs Tangle-Barbs: instantly E off a wall for the stun and attack-speed surge, Q-recast for the true-damage second hit, W to heal, and R to isolate him if he tries to run. Bad trade: Burning Hookshot (E) aggressively, missing the stun, and getting stuck in a drawn-out melee grind while your E and shield are down. That is how Camille loses a winning lane.

notes: The best counter Camille owns in this matchup is not on the page: Inherent Glamour breaks on any immobilizing crowd control, so Hookshot's knock-up strips a disguised Neeko's cover. The page instead repeats 'never facecheck the clone' without ever giving the tool that answers it. The other omission is dangerous in the opposite direction - Pop Blossom's wind-up is HIDDEN while she is disguised, which means the usual 'watch for the channel' instinct fails exactly when it matters. 'Her flash/Q escape' in wants.you[1] invents mobility on Blooming Burst, a thrown seed. CHART CONTRADICTION: win[4]/phases[4] say Neeko wins level 6 while spikes[1], mid and whys[4] all say it is Camille's cleanest window; I did not resolve it, see questionsForUser.
